Clips include a female gymnast performing a floor routine, astronauts in orange jumpsuits walking down a ramp, a man smiling at a marathon, a female figure skater reacting with joy, a male basketball player holding up a jersey, people celebrating in white clothing with tambourines and fireworks, a male soccer player on a field, Joe Biden and Barack Obama hugging with Kamala Harris smiling behind them, a young woman walking on a suburban street, and a man in a suit drinking boba tea in a grocery store.
